📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Juan Hill. Dry cleaner. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Daughter's Drawing, Dispatcher's headset, Knife roll, Spare Socks, Brass Locket. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people.
